verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vercel has REST API endpoint reference pages, such as versioned paths like GET /v3/deployments/{idOrUrl}/events, and a published OpenAPI description at openapi.json. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable try-it examples. A static reference plus a machine-readable spec is adjacent support that someone could build an explorer from, not the interactive capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
